high_level_description: The image shows two women sitting closely together at what appears to be a fashion event. The woman on the left has short, vibrant teal hair and is wearing a white sleeveless top paired with black leather pants. She has sunglasses hanging from her top and is smiling warmly at the camera. The woman on the right has shoulder-length reddish-brown hair and is dressed in a denim jacket over a denim shirt, paired with blue jeans. She is also smiling and appears to be leaning slightly towards the other woman.
